job.job_description:
We are looking for a skilled Prompt Engineer with 4 to 15 years of experience in the field.

Roles and Responsibility

Design and develop innovative AI models using Gen AI, LLM, RaG, and Ajentic AI.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into existing systems.
Develop and implement automated testing frameworks to ensure high-quality AI model delivery.
Work closely with data engineers to design and implement data pipelines for AI model training.
Conduct thorough analysis of AI model performance and provide recommendations for improvement.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends and advancements in AI technologies.

Job Requirements

Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python or Java.
Experience with deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Knowledge of natural language processing techniques and their applications.
Familiarity with cloud-based platforms for deploying AI models at scale.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
